description: Institut national de l'information géographique et forestière: positioning datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Institut national de l'information géographique et forestière. Coverage: Institut national de l'information géographique et forestière. The listing groups 3 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about positioning; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Fiches signalétiques des points géodésiques et des repères de nivellem; GEODESIE ET NIVELLEMENT; Répertoire de données de référence géodésiques et des codelists ISO 19. Formats seen: HTML, WMS, WFS, XML. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf), as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
